release_note_review.surface: claude -p exiting 0 when a full disk or quota lost its transcript or ~/.claude.json writes
release_note_review.reason: Response-only requires an init frame, one text turn, and one matching result, and fails closed without them. The provider now reports the write loss and exits 1 instead of exiting 0 silently. No init field changes.

The plugin joins the builtins that load regardless under --safe-mode. Its tool.check hooks cover web and shell tools and response-only runs with empty tools, so the ask path is unreachable. It contributes no MCP server, and safe-mode independently blocks auto-discovered MCP.

release_note_review.surface: onFailure block for Agent SDK hook callbacks
release_note_review.reason: The SDK callback API is not a CLI route surface; the literal is absent from both shipped executables.

release_note_review.surface: nested claude -p session identity fixes and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID
release_note_review.reason: Response-only spawns the CLI with --no-session-persistence from an adapter-owned empty directory and never inside a provider session.

release_note_review.surface: Read stub removal and Grep/Glob time-limit completeness
release_note_review.reason: Payload-level tool-result text; unreachable because response-only runs with zero tools. The strict empty-tools init contract is unchanged.
Provider disk hygiene; response-only disables session persistence and maps no transcript store.
